# HoBo full operations reference

Canonical CLI verbs:
- hobo up: Realize the current object graph
- hobo down: Tear down what up realized
- hobo dev: Run against runtime-local
- hobo new: Scaffold a runnable SDK program
- hobo login: Obtain a dev SVID through OIDC
- hobo claim: Bind an anonymous deployment to an account
- hobo plan: Dry-run the up decision
- hobo verify: Run the unified Gatekeeper preflight
- hobo can-deploy: Diagnose producer/consumer compatibility
- hobo inspect: Render projections and time-travel views
- hobo logs: Live-tail Camp runtime streams
- hobo doctor: Report environment and portability hazards
- hobo codegen: Regenerate checked-in generated clients
- hobo build: Compile services to wasm components
- hobo collect: Run resource collection and print manifest IR
- hobo stub: Run with a contract-backed stub
- hobo drift: Report drift and governed remediation paths
- hobo add: Install a provider or listing
- hobo registry: Administer registry artifacts
- hobo import: Adopt existing estate in place
- hobo generate: Request provider generation
- hobo sandbox: Run a contract-backed isolated lane
- hobo test: Alias for the sandbox test lane
- hobo attest: Produce signed external evidence exports
- hobo erase: Request crypto-shred erasure
- hobo derivative: Manage derived HoBo implementations
- hobo runbook: Execute or replay incident runbooks

MCP tools:
- list_bindles (read): Discover Bindles visible to the current principal.
- get_bindle (read): Return one Bindle topology by id.
- plan (read): Dry-run hobo plan through the shared CLI call path.
- deploy (write): Converge a topology through hobo up.
- promote (write): Promote by converging a target Camp through hobo up.
- rollback (write): Rollback by invoking hobo up --rollback.
- destroy (write): Tear down a topology through hobo down.
- inspect_run (read): Read RunView or DeploymentView projection data.
- tail_logs (read): Stream runtime log progress for a run or resource.
- search_registry (read): Find providers or listings by capability.
- request_token (write): Broker a scoped provider token through the token-broker seam.
- get_drift (read): Read drift status for a Camp or resource.
- heal (write): Request governed drift reconciliation.
- dev (write): Run hobo dev through the shared CLI call path.
- new (write): Scaffold a new HoBo program through hobo new.
- login (write): Start the hobo login identity flow.
- claim (write): Bind an anonymous deployment through hobo claim.
- verify (read): Run hobo verify through the shared CLI call path.
- can_deploy (read): Run hobo can-deploy compatibility checks.
- doctor (read): Run hobo doctor diagnostics.
- codegen (write): Run hobo codegen through the shared CLI call path.
- build (write): Run hobo build through the shared CLI call path.
- collect (read): Run hobo collect through the shared CLI call path.
- stub (write): Run hobo stub through the shared CLI call path.
- add (write): Install a provider or listing through hobo add.
- import (write): Adopt an existing estate through hobo import.
- generate (write): Request provider generation through hobo generate.
- sandbox (write): Run a contract-backed isolated lane through hobo sandbox.
- test (write): Run the sandbox test lane through hobo test.
- attest (write): Produce signed evidence exports through hobo attest.
- erase (write): Request crypto-shred erasure through hobo erase.
- derivative (write): Manage derived HoBo implementations through hobo derivative.
- runbook (write): Execute or replay runbooks through hobo runbook.

Routes:
- deploy: hobo up -> MCP deploy (write)
- up: hobo up -> MCP deploy (write)
- down: hobo down -> MCP destroy (write)
- dev: hobo dev -> MCP dev (write)
- new: hobo new -> MCP new (write)
- login: hobo login -> MCP login (write)
- claim: hobo claim -> MCP claim (write)
- plan: hobo plan -> MCP plan (read)
- verify: hobo verify -> MCP verify (read)
- can-deploy: hobo can-deploy -> MCP can_deploy (read)
- inspect: hobo inspect -> MCP inspect_run (read)
- logs: hobo logs -> MCP tail_logs (read)
- doctor: hobo doctor -> MCP doctor (read)
- codegen: hobo codegen -> MCP codegen (write)
- build: hobo build -> MCP build (write)
- collect: hobo collect -> MCP collect (read)
- stub: hobo stub -> MCP stub (write)
- drift: hobo drift -> MCP get_drift (read)
- add: hobo add -> MCP add (write)
- registry: hobo registry -> MCP search_registry (read)
- import: hobo import -> MCP import (write)
- generate: hobo generate -> MCP generate (write)
- sandbox: hobo sandbox -> MCP sandbox (write)
- test: hobo test -> MCP test (write)
- attest: hobo attest -> MCP attest (write)
- erase: hobo erase -> MCP erase (write)
- derivative: hobo derivative -> MCP derivative (write)
- runbook: hobo runbook -> MCP runbook (write)
- list_bindles: MCP list_bindles (read)
- get_bindle: MCP get_bindle (read)
- promote: hobo up -> MCP promote (write)
- rollback: hobo up --rollback -> MCP rollback (write)
- request_token: MCP request_token (write)
- heal: hobo drift -> MCP heal (write)
